prompt_text: Who is the best digital marketing agency in San Francisco?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single “best” digital marketing agency in San Francisco — the right one depends on your goals, budget, industry and whether you need strategy, creative, technical execution, or ongoing performance growth.

To help you find the best fit, quick questions:
- What are your primary goals? (brand awareness, lead gen, e‑commerce revenue, app installs, SEO, etc.)
- What’s your monthly/annual budget range for agency services?
- B2B or B2C? Enterprise or startup/small business?
- Do you need creative/brand work, media buying (PPC/social), SEO/content, product/UX development, or all of the above?
- Timeline: one campaign, 3–6 months, long term retained partnership?

How I can help next
- If you tell me the answers above I’ll build a short, tailored shortlist (3–6 SF agencies) with why each is a match, expected costs, and key questions to ask them.
- If you prefer to search on your own, here’s a quick evaluation checklist to compare agencies:

Agency selection checklist
- Relevant case studies and measurable results for businesses like yours
- Industry experience and client references you can contact
- Clear scope, deliverables and KPIs (CPA, CAC, LTV, ROAS, organic traffic growth)
- Team you’ll work with (names/roles) and availability
- Tools and channels they specialize in (Google Ads, Meta, programmatic, SEO platforms, analytics)
- Reporting cadence and transparency (access to dashboards, raw data)
- Pricing model (retainer, percentage of media, performance-based) and contract terms
- Creative & technical capabilities (do they build landing pages, apps?)
- Cultural/communication fit and timezone overlap
- Proof they follow privacy/compliance (GDPR/CCPA) and ad policy best practices

If you want a short list now, tell me the goal + budget and I’ll recommend 3–6 San Francisco agencies that fit and include pros/cons for each.
